confidence_notes: Recent Krabi aggregates give useful anchors for meals, coffee and beer. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass prices are bounded estimates using local beer and wine price relationships; accommodation is holistic and varies with beach area and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct Krabi aggregate prices anchor meals, coffee and draft beer. No proxy city price series was used; accommodation and drinks without a direct city average are estimates based on Krabi's Thai coastal tourism profile.
